meta.title: English Reading Aid
meta.description: Click or select an English word in the conversation to see its meaning; select a pure-English sentence to translate into Chinese. Includes a wordbook, root analysis, word-family highlighting, in-text word marking, and spaced review.

youdao.title: Youdao sync
youdao.hint: Pull your Youdao Dictionary favorites into the wordbook in one go.
youdao.guideTitle: Connect your Youdao account in four steps
youdao.step1: Open dict.youdao.com in your browser and sign in.
youdao.step2: Press F12 → Network → refresh the page → click the first request.
youdao.step3: In Request Headers, find Cookie and copy the whole value.
youdao.step4: Paste it into the box below and click "Save and verify".
youdao.invalid: Cookie expired — please copy a new one
youdao.downgradeHint: You can export manually: open the Youdao wordbook page, select all, copy, and paste it on the Import tab.
youdao.placeholder: This panel is wired up in the next version: paste your Cookie, fetch favorites, see progress. For now, use the Import tab and paste a Youdao export.
